data.title: Ethereum gains 20% as BitMEX co-founder buys $2... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum surged over 20% after holding key support near $1,580, attracting $104 million in spot ETF inflows over three weeks. BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes strategically bought 1,290 ETH worth $2.5 million, signaling confidence despite resistance levels. Technical analysts forecast long-term price targets between $10,000 and $20,000, with immediate resistance at $1,945 and $2,145. Futures data shows rising bullish sentiment, supporting optimism for further gains.
